english.note: Use this when you get someone to agree by coaxing, sweet-talking, or indulging them rather than by giving reasons.

exampleSentences.english: I had to sweet-talk him for ages before I could persuade him to come with me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我氹咗佢好耐，佢先肯同我去。
